original_plan.thesis: Baker Hughes printed a record $10.5B in Q2 orders (+49% YoY), including a record $7.1B in Industrial & Energy Technology bookings, and raised both its FY2026 guidance (revenue to $27.35B, adjusted EBITDA to $4.85B) and its 2026-2028 IET orders outlook to over $45B (earnings release, 2026-07-27). The stock confirmed a volume breakout the same day (+5.83%, 1.76x average volume, pocket pivot, gap 99% retained) after basing for two weeks following a -22% decline from May's highs, reclaiming both its 20- and 50-day moving averages off a double bottom near $53-55 -- visually confirmed on the 6-month daily chart; live price has digested modestly to $58.28 today (-3.8% from the 2026-07-27 post-earnings close) but remains above that reclaim shelf, which reads as normal post-breakout digestion rather than a failed breakout. The bundle's own sec_filings confirms Baker Hughes closed an acquisition on 2026-07-16 (8-K on file), which the earnings-release excerpt identifies as Chart Industries; the specific deal size ($13.6B all-cash) and synergy target ($325M by year three) are not themselves printed in this bundle and are cited here as WebSearch-verified facts (GlobeNewswire and StockTitan coverage of Baker Hughes' 2026-07-16 press release), not bundle facts -- flagged explicitly so this is judged as external verification, not an implied bundle citation. TD Cowen maintained its Buy rating and raised its price target to $78 today (2026-07-28), and a headline published today quotes the CEO directly attributing growth to AI-driven power demand and energy security. Insider selling is routine 10b5-1 plan activity only. The digest's net_debt_to_ebitda of -3.37x (net cash) is from the 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 and PRE-DATES the Chart Industries close on 2026-07-16 -- post-close leverage is materially higher than this trailing figure, though $3.1B TTM free cash flow supports rapid deleveraging. Unlike today's AI-momentum names (SNOW, HPE, ANET), which are selling off hard on a live, verified factor unwind, this setup is fundamentals- and catalyst-driven -- a deliberately orthogonal bet, low-beta (0.48), with no earnings inside the 90-day window (next print 2026-10-22).

Early tell: a daily close back below $56 on rising volume, or the energy_power sector_rotation_30d trend reversing from its current acceleration.

risk_adjusted.note: Ratios are None until n_observations >= 60: computed on fewer days they are noise, not signal.

performance_breakdown.note: Your own results by category - weight your confidence using this evidence. Rates are WITHHELD (null) below the sample floor - counts are facts, a win rate off two trades is not.

calibration.note: Realized win rate vs the confidence you STATED at entry, by bucket. A large negative calibration_gap_pct means your confidence is inflated; cap stated confidence until the gap closes (per the Learning Protocol).

target_calibration.note: Grades the claim behind min_risk_reward_ratio. Targets stay NON-BINDING for exits (letting winners run is correct); this measures whether the claimed RR was ever real. rr_inflation is WITHHELD until the sample binds.
